_comment: CURATED COMMUNITY LIST (not official open data): 24/7 international news channels the project owner chose for the 國際新聞直播 panel. Every tile is labelled 第三方 / third-party. Live state is resolved at runtime by probeLive (hqdefault_live.jpg).
_verification: Audit every id with `node web/scripts/probe-livestreams.mjs` (point it at this file) or re-resolve channels with `node web/scripts/resolve-live-news.mjs`. MEASURED 2026-09-27.
_selection_rule: ONLY channels that stream 24/7 and brand themselves as such go in this file. The resolver surfaces plenty of ids that are today's EVENT feed — @financialtimes returned a weekend festival, @tbsnewsdig and @ANNnewsCH put the date in the live title and rotate daily, @ETtoday returned a single rally. Hardcoding any of those recreates the GxMB-EH_lJs bug documented in live_streams.json: the id dies with the event and the tile silently 404s. If a title contains a date or an event name, it does NOT belong in this file.
_hk_gap: There is no Hong Kong entry here, deliberately. RTHK only does event feeds, and TVB / i-CABLE / now / HOY keep their news channels inside their own apps — none of them offers a free 24/7 YouTube news stream. See hkcm-live-news.md for the 12 handles that were tested and returned 404 or no live. HK coverage stays on the camera wall, which is a genuine strength: 1,013 TD + 34 HKO cameras is a density no global project has.
source_name: 第三方 YouTube 國際新聞直播
